title: Science
subtitle: Research, analysis, and discovery
intro: Science is at the center of every mission where curiosity matters more than brute force. On the Cori, this department studies anomalies, evaluates scans, develops theories, and brings structure to anything that first appears unexplained.
focusItems: Research into anomalies and unusual phenomena
Interpretation of unknown signals and contacts
missionExamples: Investigation of alien technology or environmental conditions
Development of hypotheses and mission reports
cultureText: Science aboard the Cori is driven by curiosity, precision, and a genuine interest in asking better questions. Anyone who enjoys observing, connecting ideas, discussing theories, and making discoveries will fit in well here.
